description: This file is an HTML document implementing a webpage for the CodeMirror editor configured with LiveScript syntax highlighting. The core content within the <textarea> defines the actual LiveScript source code used to demonstrate the mode. The file includes references to external CSS and JavaScript files and contains embedded LiveScript code that defines various functional programming utilities. It is primarily a webpage that showcases the LiveScript mode for CodeMirror, not a typical source code file of a programming project.
